assetStatus: Already implemented — a hand-built React Three Fiber scene (EarthSpaceViewer.tsx, mode="phases"), not a pending asset. Earth and the Moon render from the same real, already-cleared GLBs used elsewhere in Space (see src/data/moons.ts's moon entry and modelRegistry.ts for provenance/license).
visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow/bloom. The Moon orbits Earth at the learner-set angle; its lit crescent/gibbous shape is real-time directional lighting from the Sun's fixed position, matched live against the eight-phase wheel readout in the side panel.
materialNotes: Earth and Moon use their existing real GLB material sets (metallic-roughness PBR); no emissive channels — the lit fraction is real-time directional lighting, not a texture swap between phase images.
note: Process-driven component: the 'Touch it' interaction is a live physics simulation (a moon-angle slider plus phase-wheel presets) rather than tapping points on a single model, so this component intentionally carries no hotspots.
